Sarah — thanks, glad the demo was useful. High level answers below and I've attached a concise ratecard + an SLA draft for Legal: Redwood_Dedicated_Ratecard_v2.xlsx and SLA-draft-Redwood.pdf.

Quick summary (will expand if useful):

Option A — Standard Dedicated (shared tenancy pools, reserved commit):
- Base price: $X per GPU-hour equivalent (see attachment)
- Throughput guidance: a 4x-A100-equivalent pool supports ~300 req/s of mixed-short prompts with p95 generation latency target of <350ms for short prompts.

Option B — Single-tenant / Isolated Pool (what you asked about):
- Isolation surcharge: additive line item typically 18%–35% depending on retention and KMS/HSM requirements.
- KMS integration: +flat setup fee (one-time) for customer-managed keys + recurring KMS call overhead (metered). HSM-backed keys add an additional premium and lead time.
- Audit logging: 12-month retention included in standard isolation tier; 24-month is charged per-GB/month for log storage and immutable retention (+ small indexing fee).
- Dedicated VPC endpoints and additional routable IPs: fixed monthly.
- Failover: automatic regional fallback supported but we keep the pool isolated within the customer VPC; fallback is to a pre-approved, compatible isolated variant in another region — this is part of the SLA.

Sizing guidance for your 300 req/s profile:
- Recommend a dedicated pool of 6 x A100-equivalent GPUs (continuous) with autoscaling headroom to burst +30% for peaks.
- With prefix KV caching and batching tuned for your prompt-distribution we expect ~22% token-cost reduction vs naive single-request serving.

Next steps: I can get you a draft order with three price bands (12m commit, 24m commit, and pay-as-you-go) by EOD if you want.

Attaching the ratecard and SLA draft now. If you can share an estimated monthly token volume and percent long-context prompts (>= 2k tokens) I will include a discounted commit scenario.

Monica / Karthik — quick take from pricing/SE side:

Technical and sizing notes:
- For a 300 req/s mixed workload, 6 x A100-equivalent is the safe baseline. If 30% of requests are long-context (>2k tokens) bump to 8 GPUs.
- Isolation requirements (KMS/HSM + immutable logs) increase storage and operational overhead; expect ~0.12–0.18 additional CPU/GPU-equivalent overhead for log ingestion and indexing (we account for that in the surcharge).

Rate guidance (proposal):
- Base reserved price (12m commit): $9.80 / GPU-hour-equivalent (list numbers internal; we should keep the public ratecard in the attachment).
- Isolation surcharge: 22% of base monthly cost (breakdown: 12% operational isolation, 6% KMS/HSM & key-management ops, 4% audit-log retention and immutable-storage guard rails).
- KMS setup fee: $10k one-time for customer-managed KMS integration (includes HSM onboarding optional + policy review).
- Audit-log 24m retention: $0.035 / GB / month for immutable archive; indexing/search + $1,200 / month baseline.
- Dedicated VPC endpoints & egress: $1,300 / month.

Discounting and concessions:
- For a 12m commit at your target $10k/month reserved equivalent we can offer: 10% off base reserved price and waive the one-time KMS setup fee if they commit to 12 months and agree to a 30% uplift threshold in the first 90 days (operational usage check).
- If legal wants a deeper concession on the isolation surcharge we can run a promo to 15% for this deal only, but that should be tied to a 24m commit or a higher monthly committed spend (>$20k/month).

I'll draft the pricing table and the suggested contract language for the KMS/HSM SLAs. Monica — if you want, I can be on the call with Novacorp this week to walk through the cost breakdown.
